description: This Java class defines a Spring Batch item reader for aggregating journal entries within a specified date range, mapping database query results to data objects for further processing.

classes.name: JournalEntryAggregationJobReader
classes.description: A Spring Batch JDBC cursor item reader that fetches aggregated journal entry data within a date range, configured with SQL and row mapping logic.

methods.name: JournalEntryAggregationJobReader
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the data source, SQL query, and row mapper based on tenant context.

methods.name: beforeStep
methods.description: Prepares the date range parameters for the SQL query before executing each batch step.

methods.name: mapRow
methods.description: Maps a SQL ResultSet row to a JournalEntryAggregationSummaryData object.

methods.name: buildAggregationQuery
methods.description: Builds the SQL query string used to fetch aggregated journal entries.
